info.title: AI-IDS
info.description: Network intrusion detection: uploads, open-set predictions, explanations, admin.

get.description: Liveness: the process is up (used by the container healthcheck).
Readiness: database, Redis and an active model bundle are all available.

post.description:
multipart/form-data with one file in the field `file`: a CSV exported by CICFlowMeter
(or a PCAP / PCAPNG capture when enabled). The type is read from the file's content.

get.description: Your totals: uploads per status, bytes, flows, known attacks and unknowns found.
Status, progress and error of one upload (owner or admin).

delete.description: Delete the file and its results (owner or admin). The upload still counts in usage totals.

get.description: Decision counts, known attacks per type, unknowns per reason, and the model that produced them.
One page of flows with their predictions, optionally filtered by decision and/or class.
Which features drove this flow's decision, computed with the bundle that produced it.
Download the results as CSV: row, metadata, Label, predictions (and optionally features).

patch.description:
Deactivate/reactivate (deactivation ends the user's sessions) and promote/demote, each audited.
Nobody can change their own role or status, and the last active admin can't be removed.

get.description: Per-user totals for uploads created in the period, plus storage held right now.
One user's uploads per UTC day (default: the last 30 days, at most 366).

schema.description: e.g. model.activate, or user. for a family

get.description:
Host, database, Redis, queue, uploads and model state of the API process that answers,
with warnings. Takes about a second (CPU sampling and a worker ping).
